description:
Use this when the user asks how two people get on in a bond other than marriage — business partners, siblings, a parent and child, or friends.
Reads the bond the way the classical method reads it: the houses that govern this kind of bond and their lords in each chart, the natural significators, whose planets fall in whose governing houses, and whether that reach runs both ways, plus the running periods in each chart that engage the bond. A bond meter (strong tie, workable or strained) is computed by a stated convention and returned with every point it is built from; it is not a classical score, since the texts give no arithmetic for a business or sibling match. Deterministic: no language model is called. Both birth times are required. For marriage, use the compatibility tool.
Cost: 8 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"type":"business","a":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209,"name":"A"},"b":{"date":"1991-11-03","time":"06:10","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":19.076,"longitude":72.8777,"name":"B"}}
